loc[]                              Allows for accessing data in a DataFrame using row/column labels.

 iloc[]                             Allows for accessing data in a DataFrame using row/column
                                    integer-based indexes.

 df[condition]                      Selects only the rows that meet the given condition.

 df.loc[start_row:end_row,
 start_column:end_column]           Slices using label ranges.

0     False       True      False
                                                                                               The df.isnull()
                                                       1     False      False      False       function returns a
                                                                                               Boolean array with

df.loc[[label1, label2,
                                    Slices rows that are in the list [label1, label2, ...].
 ...], :]

                                    Returns a Boolean array with Boolean values representing whether
 df.isnull()
                                    each entry has been Null.

 fillna()                           Replaces Null values.

 dropna()                           Removes all rows containing a Null value.
